boundary_evidence: PARTIAL RUN, 22 of 61. tu_map calls 0x20ea280..0x20ede18 one contiguous linker run of 61 function(s) (build/tu_map.json, tools/tu_map.py). This TU licenses 0x020eb018..0x020ec458, 22 function(s), ROM ordinals 13..34. Of the other 39, 38 keep their own shards and their own delinks.txt entries; the 39th is the sourceless hole in EDGE 1 below, which has neither. Counted directly from the post-promotion delinks.txt: 39 .text blocks inside the run, one of them this TU, 38 per-function shards, and exactly one gap (0x020ea914..0x020eac38).

EDGE 1 -- a sourceless hole splits the run. ROM ordinal 11, func_ov006_020ea914 (0x020ea914, size 0x324), has no source anywhere in the tree: it is a banked near-miss (config/match_attempts.jsonl, best 113 divergences, size-exact but mis-coloured) and carries no entry in config/arm9/overlays/ov006/delinks.txt at all -- the cartridge's own bytes cover that range. It sits in the MIDDLE of the run, and no delink block and no TU manifest anywhere in this tree expresses a .text claim with a hole in it (both checked tree-wide: zero of each carries two .text runs). So the run can only be licensed as one of its two contiguous sides; ordinals 0..10 (0x020ea280..0x020ea914, 11 functions, including the destructor pair) are the smaller side and stay out.

EDGE 2 -- two file-global pragmas contradict each other inside the larger side. Four of its 49 functions reproduce only with `#pragma opt_strength_reduction off` (func_ov006_020eac38, func_ov006_020ec458, func_ov006_020ec93c, func_ov006_020ec9c0 -- each carried it in its own legacy file) and three only with it on (func_ov006_020ebf20, func_ov006_020ec2bc, func_ov006_020ecba4). _ZN15dScMgHanachan_c6RenderEv carried `#pragma opt_common_subs off`, which costs five other members when set. Both settings are FILE-GLOBAL last-wins in mwccarm 2004/b56, re-measured on this TU: bracketing opt_strength_reduction `off ... on` around exactly the four members that want it produced byte-for-byte the same 41/49 as omitting it entirely, so there is no positional escape. Measured whole-side scores with every other reconciliation held identical: SR off / OCS on = 44/49; SR on / OCS on = 42/49; SR off / OCS off = 40/49. Promotion needs a CONTIGUOUS run in which every function matches, and the longest such run over all three settings is ordinals 13..34 under SR on -- the 22 licensed here. The longest under SR off is ordinals 12..31, only 20.

NOT a destructor-order refusal. The ROM orders this class D1 (0x020ea280) BELOW D0 (0x020ea2c8), which is the reproducible direction (inline-in-class => D1 then D0) and would have promoted whole; the pair is out only because it lies on the far side of the sourceless hole. Consequently this TU does not own the class's key function -- the first declared virtual is the out-of-line ~dScMgHanachan_c() -- so it emits no _ZTV/_ZTI/_ZTS, needs no compiler_only_output block (verify reports zero unlicensed symbols), and needed no header edit: include/dScMgHanachan_c.h keeps the out-of-line destructor declaration that the two still-enrolled destructor shards require.
